Item.Name: S_SCAN_FIELD
Item.Hint: Scan barcode label to be verified; [COMMIT] to print report

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 field_len number;
 start_1 VARCHAR2(1);
 start_2 VARCHAR2(1);
 term_1 VARCHAR2(1);
 term_2 VARCHAR2(1);
 save_scan varchar2(15);
BEGIN
 save_scan := :display.s_scan_field;
 while (:SYSTEM.last_record = 'FALSE') loop
 down;
 end loop;
 if (:display.verification_no is not null) then
 down;
 end if;
 :display.s_scan_field := save_scan;
 select nvl(NVL(length(:display.s_scan_field), 0), 0) into field_len
 from dual;
 if (field_len < 2) then
message ('Msg: A barcode label must be scanned, or press [EXIT].');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 select upper(substr(:display.s_scan_field, 1, 1)) into start_1
 from dual;
 select upper(substr(:display.s_scan_field, 2, 1)) into start_2
 from dual;
 select upper(substr(:display.s_scan_field, field_len, 1))
 into term_1
 from dual;
 select upper(substr(:display.s_scan_field, field_len-1, 1))
 into term_2
 from dual;
 if (field_len = 5) then
 if (start_1 = 'D' and term_1 = 'B') then
 if (term_2 = '$') then
 execute_trigger ('primary_collection_label');
 elsif (term_2 = '+') then
 execute_trigger ('satellite_transfer_label');
 elsif (term_2 = '0') then
 execute_trigger ('blood_type_label');
 else
 execute_trigger ('scan_error');
 end if;
 else
 execute_trigger ('scan_error');
 end if;
 elsif (field_len = 6) then
 if (start_1 = 'C' and term_2 = '3' and term_1 = 'B') then
 execute_trigger ('attribute_label');
 else
 execute_trigger ('scan_error');
 end if;
 elsif (field_len = 7) then
 if (start_1 = 'A' and term_1 = 'C') then
 execute_trigger ('expire_date_label');
 elsif (start_1 = 'B' and term_1 = 'D') then
 execute_trigger ('donor_exclusion_label');
 else
 execute_trigger ('scan_error');
 end if;
 elsif (field_len = 8) then
 if (start_1 = 'A' and term_1 = 'C') then
 execute_trigger ('expire_date_label');
 else
 execute_trigger ('scan_error');
 end if;
 elsif (field_len = 9) then
 if (start_1 = 'A' and start_2 = '0' and
 term_2 = '3' and term_1 = 'B') then
 execute_trigger ('component_label');
 elsif (start_1 = 'D' and term_1 = 'D') then
 execute_trigger ('unit_label');
 else
 execute_trigger ('scan_error');
 end if;
 elsif (field_len = 11) then
 if (start_1 = 'A' and start_2 = '0' and
 term_2 = '1' and term_1 = 'B') then
 execute_trigger ('registration_label');
 else
 execute_trigger ('scan_error');
 end if;
 else
 execute_trigger ('scan_error');
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GEN_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure gen_report(program_name in VARCHAR2,
 id in VARCHAR2) is
 temp_count NUMBER;
 temp_parm VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_printer VARCHAR2(10);
begin
 if program_name is null or id is null
 then
 show_error('0901'); -- null parameter
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 temp_parm := 'USRID';
 temp_count := 0;
begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from rpt_parm
 where appl_id = 'DON' and
 user_name = :banner.user_id and
 report_name = program_name and
 parm_id = id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm
 (appl_id,user_name,report_name,parm_id,
 parm_date,submit_date,report_status)
 values
 ('DON',:banner.user_id,program_name,
 id,sysdate,sysdate,'E');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 delete from rpt_parm_select
 where appl_id = 'DON' and
 user_name = :banner.user_id and
 report_name = program_name and
 parm_id = id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 values
 ('DON',:banner.user_id,program_name,
 id, 1, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, 'CHP');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 values
 ('DON',:banner.user_id,program_name,
 id, 2, id, temp_parm);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_success
 then
 show_error('0000'); /* transaction committed */
 check_package_failure;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 show_error('0600'); /* unsuccessful commit */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 begin
 select nvl(print_id, 'hplaser3si')
 into temp_printer
 from system_users
 where chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and ( user_id = :banner.user_id
 or user_id = 'OPS$' || :banner.user_id);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 host ('nohup repgen.sh -a'||'SBC '||
 '-t'||'PC '||
 '-r'||program_name||' '||
 '-p'||id||' '||
 '-u'||:banner.user_id||' '||
 '-q'|| temp_printer ||' '||
 '-f'||'COMPRESSED '||
 ' -l '||
 '-c'||:GLOBAL.chapter_id||' &');
end;

 and mc.code = :display.label_type;
 select decode (NVL(length(:display.s_scan_field), 0),

 substr(:display.s_scan_field,2,6))
 into :display.label_value
 from dual
 where :display.s_scan_field is not null;
 BEGIN
 select to_char(to_date(substr(:display.s_scan_field,2,2)||'-'||
 substr(:display.s_scan_field,4,2)||'-'||
 decode (NVL(length(:display.s_scan_field), 0),
 7, '9'||substr(:display.s_scan_field,6,1),
 substr(:display.s_scan_field,6,2)),
 'MM-DD-RR'), 'MM-DD-RR')
 into :display.label_inter
 from dual;
 EXCEPTION

 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END;
 execute_trigger ('pop_hdr_details');

 GO_ITEM ('s_scan_field');
END;
